description: Signed up but no completed purchase before the snapshot.
First purchase within the last 60 days.
Bought recently, often and with high net spend (R>=4, F>=4, M>=4).
Recent buyers with few orders so far (R>=3).
Last purchase more than 240 days ago (R=1).
At least 3 support cases in 180 days and service cost >= 10% of net spend.
At least 3 orders and returned value >= 30% of gross spend.
